about.title: About Chirp
about.intro: Pet lovebirds rely heavily on vocalization to communicate their needs and emotional states. However, human caretakers often interpret these sounds intuitively, which may lead to misunderstanding or overlooked stress signals.
about.challengeDesc: Lovebirds use complex vocalizations that are difficult for humans to interpret accurately
about.solutionDesc: AI-powered audio analysis to identify patterns and classify vocal behaviors
about.impactDesc: More empathetic care and stronger bonds between caretakers and their beloved pets
about.aim1: Explore patterns in lovebird vocalizations using audio analysis
about.aim2: Classify common vocal sounds into broad behavioral or emotional categories
about.aim3: Provide interpretable feedback to support better pet care
about.notAimTitle: What We Do NOT Aim To Do
about.notAim2: Replace human observation or veterinary advice
about.disclaimer: Chirp is a supportive tool designed to enhance, not replace, your natural connection with your pet.
about.developerBio: Julie Zhu is a high school researcher and developer passionate about the intersection of biology and technology. She is the creator of Chirp, combining computational modeling with behavioral science to improve human–bird interaction. Julie is also the founder of
about.developerBioEnd: , showcasing her interest in debate and public speaking. With a strong foundation in biology and physics, she approaches every project with curiosity, rigor, and a focus on real-world impact.

collect.title: Collect Audio Database
collect.description: Gather a comprehensive database of lovebird vocalizations across various contexts, emotional states, and environmental conditions. Each sound is carefully annotated and categorized.
collect.details: Our dataset includes thousands of audio samples from different lovebird species, capturing chirps, calls, and songs in diverse situations.

vas.title: VAS Value Inference
vas.description: Extract and infer VAS (Valence, Arousal, Social Engagement) values from each audio sample using advanced signal processing and feature extraction techniques.
vas.details: Valence measures positive/negative emotion, Arousal indicates energy level, and Social Engagement reflects interaction intent.

cnn.title: CNN Machine Learning
cnn.description: Train deep Convolutional Neural Networks on audio spectrograms to recognize complex patterns in vocal expressions and correlate them with emotional states.
cnn.details: Our CNN architecture analyzes frequency, duration, amplitude, and temporal patterns to build robust predictive models.

classify.title: Classification & Advice
classify.description: Generate emotion classifications with confidence scores and provide data-driven care recommendations tailored to your lovebird's specific vocal patterns.
classify.details: Receive actionable insights on your bird's needs, stress levels, and wellbeing, backed by scientific analysis.

advice.excitedHappy: Your lovebird is in a highly positive and energetic state! This is great. Continue engaging with your bird through play and social interaction.
advice.contentCalm: Your lovebird appears relaxed and content. This indicates a comfortable environment. Maintain current care routines.
advice.stressedAgitated: Your bird may be experiencing stress or discomfort. Check for environmental stressors, ensure adequate food/water, and consider a vet visit if this persists.
advice.subduedUnhappy: Your lovebird may be feeling down or unwell. Monitor closely for signs of illness and increase gentle interaction. Consult a vet if concerning.
advice.seekingInteraction: Your bird is actively seeking social engagement! Spend quality time with your lovebird through gentle handling, talking, or playtime.
advice.withdrawn: Your bird may need some quiet time. Respect their space while ensuring their basic needs are met. Gradual, gentle interaction may help.
advice.neutral: Your lovebird is in a balanced emotional state. Continue providing consistent care, enrichment, and social interaction.
